question: Which of the following countries never hosted the Asian Games till 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pakistan** has never hosted the Asian Games as of 2022.
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, are a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• South Korea has hosted the Asian Games three times: in Seoul (1986), Busan (2002), and Incheon (2014).
 
• China has hosted the Asian Games twice: in Beijing (1990) and Guangzhou (2010).
 
• Japan has hosted the Asian Games three times: in Tokyo (1958), Hiroshima (1994), and will host in Nagoya (2026).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games History**:

 
 
• The Asian Games were first held in 1951 in New Delhi, India.
 
• The games are regulated by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) under the supervision of the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
 
 
• **Hosting Countries**:
 
 
• Countries that have hosted the Asian Games include India, the Philippines, Thailand, Iran, Indonesia, and Qatar, among others.
 
 
 
• **Participation**:
 
 
• As of the latest games, nearly every Asian country participates, with athletes competing in a wide range of sports.
 
 
 
• **Future Hosts**:
 
 
• In addition to Japan (Nagoya 2026), other future hosts include China (Hangzhou 2023).
